overview: Full node list, grouped by this database's original functional categories (Gathering/Crafting/Management/Building). IMPORTANT: the level-gated 'Memetic Specialization' system these nodes originally belonged to — choose 1 of 4 offered every 5 levels, up to 10 by level 50 — was completely removed in the Tech System overhaul (patch 2.3.6, April 8, 2026). The current system is a single Tech Tree (branches: Survival, Production, Combat, Building) unlocked via Tech Points (from leveling, facility research, chest exploration, or Elite kills), Reverse Engineering of cultural artifacts, or Tech Invention at a research bench — see the notice on the Builds & Classes tab for the full explanation. The node names and effects below are still broadly accurate as content, but their current Tech Tree branch and unlock cost haven't been independently re-verified against the live game post-overhaul. Many nodes directly grant a blueprint (see the Blueprints section).
